sources.facts: Official hotel locates the 1983 hotel on Shamian Island along the Pearl River and describes the current lodging, restaurants and other amenities.
CTBUH/CVU tabulates the White Swan Hotel at 1 Southern Street, 100 m architectural height, 29 floors, completed in 1983.
Architectural analysis of Guangzhou hotel shading identifies slanted small balconies as the source of light-and-dark volume on the tower elevation.
Design submission documents the 2013–2015 renewal of the 1983 White Swan as the continuing Shamian Pearl River hotel.
